items.author: Musk
items.text: Tim Draper’s Elon Musk Playbook: SpaceX, Tesla and The $2 Trillion IPO
items.summary_cn: Tim Draper回顾投资马斯克 playbook，盛赞SpaceX、特斯拉及潜在2万亿美元IPO，传递看多马斯克系资产信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla's Solid Q2 Delivery Report Sent Elon Musk's Stock Down 6%. What Happened?
items.summary_cn: 特斯拉Q2交付数据强劲但股价反跌6%，市场对电动车/自动驾驶叙事与短期交付的定价出现背离。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk becomes world's first trillionaire as SpaceX soars in stock market debut
items.summary_cn: SpaceX上市首日股价飙升，马斯克成为全球首位万亿富翁，强化SPCH所追踪标的估值锚与市场情绪。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Exclusive | SpaceX Showed Investors Prototype of Elon Musk’s New AI Device
items.summary_cn: SpaceX向投资者展示马斯克新AI设备原型，跨界消费级AI硬件，模糊航天与AI边界，利好马斯克系生态叙事。

items.author: Musk
items.text: The investors scrambling to keep SpaceX – and Elon Musk – out of their portfolios
items.summary_cn: 媒体报道部分机构投资者正试图将SpaceX及马斯克相关持仓排除出组合，反映SpaceXIPO后市场对马斯克关联风险的定价分歧。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's No. 2 Says She's Giving SpaceX Stock to Trump Accounts
items.summary_cn: 马斯克二号人物Gwynne Shotwell宣布将SpaceX股票赠予'Trump Accounts'(新生儿退休账户)，暗示SpaceX资产将被嵌入新政策产品，间接扩大SpaceX散户触达面。

items.author: Musk
items.text: The town that Elon Musk built
items.summary_cn: 媒体报道马斯克在得州打造的'town that Musk built'——Starbase等社区扩张，揭示SpaceX产能与人才虹吸效应，间接支撑航天主题。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk posted twice as often on UK race and immigration as about SpaceX in IPO run-up
items.summary_cn: 报道指出SpaceXIPO路演期间，马斯克发帖频率最高的竟是英国种族与移民议题而非航天，相关舆论风险被市场关注。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Fed Reserve working paper suggests Biden illegal immigrant wave drove up home prices 30%: https://justthenews.com/government/security/fed-reserve-working-paper-suggests-biden-illegal-immigrant-wave-drove-home
items.summary_cn: 特朗普转发美联储工作论文，称拜登时期的非法移民浪潮推高房价30%，为其移民/驱逐政策辩护，间接利空住房需求侧预期。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Plants like this are going up all over the Country. Many are Defense. They are massive!
items.summary_cn: 特朗普宣传国防相关大型工厂/设施正在美国各地兴建，暗示国防工业产能扩张主题。

items.author: Trump
items.text: From Shou Chew, CEO of TikTok: “Attached are the latest numbers of the President on TikTok. All time views of #Trump TikToks are now at 425 billion. Also, 1 billion new views across UFC 250, Trump's Iran Peace Deal and “Happy Birthday, Mr. President" TikToks in just 48 hours! Wishing the President a belated happy birthday!”
items.summary_cn: TikTok CEO向特朗普汇报其平台数据，称Trump相关内容总观看量达4250亿次，间接确认TikTok在美国继续运营/未被封禁。
